notes.sowing: Plant rooted slips 2 to 5 weeks after your last frost, once the soil is above {c:18}, {cm:8} to {cm:10} deep and {cm:30} apart, ideally on a raised ridge. To grow your own slips, start a sprouting root in moist sand about 6 weeks before planting.
notes.care: Grows best at {c:21} to {c:29}. Water about {cm:2.5} a week until the vines cover the ground. Cover plants if a cold night threatens, since any frost kills them.
notes.harvest: Dig before frost and before the soil turns cold, handling the roots gently. Cure at about {c:29} and high humidity for 5 to 7 days, then store at {c:13} to {c:16}. Never refrigerate.
